description:
Is this marriage really a good idea?

Attending his ex-girlfriend’s wedding, Han-kyeong Jung experiences a Name manifestation with a man he meets there for the very first time. The problem? The man is none other than Baek-yeon Woo, the sole heir to the Wooseung Group.

News of a Name manifestation occurring at someone else's wedding—and his ex-girlfriend's at that—spreads in an instant, thrusting the two straight into the public eye. Amidst the chaotic aftermath, Baek-yeon makes an unexpected proposal to Han-kyeong.

Flustered by the sudden proposal, Han-kyeong knows he ought to refuse, but overwhelmed by Baek-yeon's stunning visual attack (?), the words that accidentally slip out of his mouth are...

*"Should we... get married?"* *(Source: RIDI, translated)*

**Original Novel:**  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/120076535), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000155554), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/marriage_pink_ebook), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=925049653), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=13358734)
